ssh.notes: Auth method enumeration (reveals supported mechanisms), credential brute force, and authenticated command execution — all require explicit authorization.

ftp.notes: FTP credential brute force, backdoor triggers (vsftpd/proftpd), heap overflow probe (CVE-2010-4221), bounce attack test, and OPIE/OTP auth issue check — all intrusive.

telnet.notes: Telnet credential brute force — creates auth log entries and may trigger lockout.

smtp.notes: SMTP credential brute force, RCPT/EXPN/VRFY user enumeration, open relay test, and Exim/Postfix exploit probes (CVE-2010-4344, CVE-2011-1720, CVE-2011-1764).

http.notes: HTTP brute force (basic, form, CMS), XSS/SQLi/CSRF injection tests, directory traversal, debug endpoint probing, open proxy check, credential exposure checks, and all http-vuln-CVE vulnerability probes — all detection/confirmation only; no state-modifying or DoS scripts.

http-alt.notes: Alternate HTTP port intrusive checks — same categories as http, detection/confirmation only.

https.notes: HTTPS intrusive checks including brute force, injection, exploit probes, and SSL/TLS vulnerability testing (Heartbleed, POODLE, CCS Injection, TLS Ticketbleed, SSLv2).

ssl/http.notes: TLS-wrapped HTTP intrusive checks — brute force, injection, and SSL exploit probes.

ssl.notes: SSL/TLS vulnerability probes: Heartbleed (CVE-2014-0160), CCS Injection (CVE-2014-0224), POODLE, DROWN, SSLv2 downgrade, and TLS Session Ticket key reuse (Ticketbleed).

smb.notes: SMB credential brute force, full domain/share/user/process/service/session enumeration, DoublePulsar backdoor detection, and vulnerability probing (EternalBlue, Conficker, MS08-067, WebExec) — all probe for exploitability without executing payloads.

microsoft-ds.notes: SMB on port 445 — same detection/confirmation coverage as smb service.

netbios-ssn.notes: NetBIOS session SMB credential and exploit checks — require explicit authorization.

mysql.notes: MySQL credential brute force, hash dump, empty-password check, audit, arbitrary query execution, and CVE-2012-2122 auth bypass exploit.

ms-sql-s.notes: MS SQL Server credential brute force, hash dump, empty-password check, xp_cmdshell RCE, query execution, and DB permission enumeration.

ms-sql-m.notes: MS SQL Server monitor port — same coverage as ms-sql-s.

ms-sql.notes: MS SQL Server credential brute force, hash dump, xp_cmdshell RCE, and query execution.

oracle-tns.notes: Oracle TNS credential brute force (standard and timing-based stealth), user enumeration, and SID brute force.

oracle.notes: Oracle credential brute force, stealth timing attack, user and SID enumeration.

vnc.notes: VNC credential brute force and RealVNC authentication bypass (affects RealVNC 3.x).

ms-wbt-server.notes: RDP MS12-020 DoS vulnerability probe — can crash unpatched Windows hosts.

rdp.notes: RDP MS12-020 DoS vulnerability probe — can crash unpatched Windows hosts.

kerberos-sec.notes: Kerberos principal/user enumeration via AS-REQ probing — reveals valid domain usernames.

ldap.notes: LDAP credential brute force and Novell eDirectory password disclosure (ldap-novell-getpass retrieves cleartext passwords).

ldapssl.notes: LDAP over SSL — same intrusive coverage as ldap.

imap.notes: IMAP credential brute force — may trigger account lockout.

imaps.notes: IMAP over SSL credential brute force.

pop3.notes: POP3 credential brute force — may trigger account lockout.

pop3s.notes: POP3 over SSL credential brute force.

snmp.notes: SNMP community string brute force — may generate significant network noise and auth log entries.

redis.notes: Redis credential brute force — unauthenticated Redis exposure is common; brute force confirms weak/no auth.

irc.notes: IRC credential brute force, SASL brute force, and UnrealIRCd 3.2.8.1 backdoor trigger (CVE-2010-2075).

sip.notes: SIP credential brute force, call spoofing attack, and user enumeration via REGISTER/OPTIONS probing.

rsync.notes: rsync module credential brute force — rsync modules can expose file system paths.

ntp.notes: NTP monlist query — reveals all recent NTP clients and is a DDoS amplification vector. Confirms misconfigured NTP.

ipmi.notes: IPMI credential brute force, cipher zero auth bypass (allows admin access without credentials on vulnerable BMCs), and Supermicro IPMI configuration file disclosure.

afp.notes: Apple Filing Protocol credential brute force and path traversal vulnerability check (CVE-2010-0533).

ajp13.notes: Apache JServ Protocol (AJP/Tomcat) credential brute force.

cvspserver.notes: CVS pserver credential brute force and repository name brute force.

iscsi.notes: iSCSI credential brute force — iSCSI targets may expose raw disk volumes.

pcanywhere.notes: pcAnywhere credential brute force — legacy remote desktop service, commonly found on older Windows systems.

netbus.notes: NetBus backdoor authentication bypass and credential brute force — NetBus is legacy RAT software.

drda.notes: IBM DB2 DRDA protocol credential brute force.

iax2.notes: IAX2 (Asterisk VoIP) credential brute force — may enumerate valid extensions.

rtsp.notes: RTSP stream URL brute force — commonly used against IP cameras and media servers.

rexec.notes: BSD rexec credential brute force — legacy plaintext remote execution service.

rlogin.notes: BSD rlogin credential brute force — legacy plaintext remote login service.

rmi.notes: Java RMI classloader exploit — allows remote code execution via arbitrary class loading on misconfigured RMI servers.

x11.notes: X11 unauthenticated access probe — confirms whether X server allows connections without auth (enables screen capture/keystroke injection).

backorifice.notes: Back Orifice RAT credential brute force — legacy malware backdoor.

samba.notes: Samba heap overflow vulnerability check (CVE-2012-1182) — pre-auth RCE in Samba < 3.6.4.

citrix-ica.notes: Citrix ICA XML service credential brute force.

nessus.notes: Nessus scanner credential brute force (daemon and XML-RPC API).

metasploit.notes: Metasploit Framework MSGRPC and XML-RPC API credential brute force.

deluge-rpc.notes: Deluge BitTorrent client RPC credential brute force.

mikrotik.notes: MikroTik RouterOS credential brute force — commonly exposed management interface on network equipment.

cics.notes: IBM CICS mainframe user credential brute force.

openvas.notes: OpenVAS scanner OTP protocol credential brute force.

omp.notes: OpenVAS Management Protocol (OMP) credential brute force.

nexpose.notes: Rapid7 Nexpose scanner credential brute force.

vmauthd.notes: VMware Authentication Daemon credential brute force — targets ESXi/VMware Server management interfaces.

rpcap.notes: Remote Packet Capture (WinPcap rpcapd) credential brute force — allows remote packet capture if compromised.

puppet.notes: Puppet master naive certificate signing check — misconfigured Puppet can allow agents to self-sign certs for unauthorized node registration.

mmouse.notes: Mobile Mouse server credential brute force.

domino.notes: IBM Domino console credential brute force and user enumeration.

nje.notes: IBM NJE (Network Job Entry) node name and password brute force — mainframe job submission protocol.

tso.notes: IBM TSO (Time Sharing Option) mainframe credential brute force.

ncp.notes: Novell Core Protocol user enumeration — reveals valid Novell/NetWare user accounts.

lu.notes: IBM LU (Logical Unit) protocol user enumeration — mainframe terminal access.

vtam.notes: IBM VTAM application enumeration — discovers accessible mainframe applications.

dicom.notes: DICOM medical imaging protocol credential brute force — may expose patient data on unprotected PACS systems.

dns.notes: DNS zone transfer (AXFR — reveals full DNS zone contents) and DNS fuzzing to probe resolver behaviour — both read/probe only.

rsa.notes: RSA ROCA factorization vulnerability check (CVE-2017-15361) — weak RSA keys generated by Infineon TPMs.

firewall.notes: Firewall ACL bypass technique testing — probes for misconfigured firewall rules allowing unauthorized access.
